title: Announcing his second account: The NextGen Leaders
oneliner: He launches a second channel, The NextGen Leaders, on the premise that technical skill alone is not enough - leadership skills complete the career.
says: The reel itself is a musical teaser - no spoken lesson, just the announcement. The caption carries the message: alongside technical skill, you need leadership skill to be successful in your career, and his new account 'The NextGen Leaders' is dedicated to that side.
explained: The split is telling about how he sees the career: this channel teaches the technical transformation (infrastructure, platform, AI); the new one teaches leading people, which he treats as a separate, equally necessary discipline.

For this site's purposes, the teaser marks the edge of the technical archive. If the people side of the architect role - influencing without authority, leading platform adoption across LOBs - is your gap, that is where he now teaches it.
takeaway: Announcement only: The NextGen Leaders is his leadership-skills channel - the complement to this one's technical content.
